summary: Slender entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Slender: The Eight Pages
entries.definitive_edition: Original freeware PC build with version/source documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original freeware build with exact version and source documented

primary.version: Original freeware PC build from developer/source archive
primary.why: The Eight Pages is a short freeware Unity horror game, distinct from the commercial sequel/remake Slender: The Arrival. The archive route is the original PC/Mac build with version, source, and input/display settings documented.
primary.how_to_play: Use the original freeware build from the developer or a preserved source. Record version, source URL/archive, OS, resolution, input/mouse sensitivity, flashlight/daylight options, page count, and whether The Arrival's re-imagined level was compared separately.

secondary.exclusive_content: Commercial sequel with a re-imagined Eight Pages-style level
secondary.why: It is not the original 2012 freeware build.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Preserved freeware builds and later commercial reworkings are separate archive targets.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not substitute Slender: The Arrival or its 2023 update for The Eight Pages.
